answer: A harbor admits 40 watch posts an epoch, each lit by a beacon only its key can read. It flashes three times in one shared 15-minute window; between real flashes it fires hollow ones, and answering one burns 20 POA. Each post locks 90 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 2,475 POA; a miss burns 25. One operator watches two posts at most, so ten fakes need five hands, thirty answers in 15 minutes. The chain checks flash times against funding roots: answers sharing one hand in a minute count as one. A farm buys bonds, not five pairs of eyes on ten beacons at once.
